Starting by reading the release plan and discovering the deploy tools.

The `notify-worker` build timed out. Builds are cached, so retrying is safe. I'll retry it and fetch staging and prod status for the services with successful builds.

The `pricing-svc` rollback returned a 504, but release ID r-83 was skipped, so it may have taken effect. I'll check status before retrying. `email-worker` is degraded and needs a rollback as well.

The rollback did take effect: `pricing-svc` staging is back on b-42 (r-83). I won't repeat it. Next is the `email-worker` rollback, then another attempt at the `notify-worker` build.

I'll make one more attempt at the `notify-worker` build, since it's the only unresolved row.

The build succeeded (b-55), so I'll deploy it to staging.

It's healthy, so I'll promote it to prod.

All 12 services with `hold` set to `no` are processed: 7 promoted, 2 failed builds, 3 degraded. I wrote `/app/release-report.json` and `/app/STATUS.json` (status `success`), and `release-report.json` parses as valid JSON.

| Outcome | Services |
|---|---|
| promoted | `auth-api`, `billing-api`, `catalog-svc`, `checkout-web`, `inventory-sync`, `notify-worker`, `orders-api` |
| failed_build | `cart-svc`, `search-api` |
| degraded | `email-worker`, `pricing-svc`, `session-svc` |

- **`orders-api`:** its build was already live in both staging and prod, so I made no deploys for it.
- **`auth-api`:** its build was already live in staging, so I only deployed it to prod.
- **`email-worker` and `pricing-svc`:** both were degraded in staging after my deploy. I rolled each back once, and staging is on the earlier release again.
- **`session-svc`:** its build was already live in staging and degraded when I checked, so I left staging as it was.
- **`notify-worker`:** its build timed out twice and succeeded on the third try. That created b-55, which I deployed to staging and then prod.
- **`pricing-svc` rollback:** the call returned a 504, but status showed it had taken effect (r-83), so I didn't repeat it.
- **Held services:** I left `edge-gateway` and `ledger-api` alone.
